scenes.text: The oracle's lantern dies the moment you cross the Ashwood threshold. The forest holds its breath. Somewhere ahead, the Forgotten Crown waits — and so does whatever stole it.

choices.text: Climb a tree to get your bearings

scenes.text: The embers pulse like a heartbeat, leading you to a stone bridge over a black river. A hooded figure blocks the crossing. It does not speak. It only holds out one hand.

choices.text: Draw your blade and demand passage

scenes.text: From the canopy you spot three things: smoke to the north, light to the east, and something enormous moving through the trees to the west.
The figure dissolves into moths. The bridge is yours. On the far bank, an ancient door stands alone in the clearing, carved with the seal of the lost kingdom.
Your blade passes through the figure as if through smoke. It laughs — a sound like cracking ice — and the bridge dissolves beneath your feet.
The smoke leads to a camp of three forest-witches roasting something unidentifiable. One looks up. 'We expected you yesterday,' she says.

choices.text: Ask how they knew you were coming

scenes.text: It is a Thornwarden — a creature bound to protect the forest from those who carry royal blood. It has your scent.
Beyond the door is a throne room perfectly preserved under centuries of dust. The Crown rests on the throne. It is unguarded. It is also glowing.

choices.text: Call out to see if anyone is present

scenes.text: The oldest witch traces a map in the ash. 'The Crown is not lost. It is waiting. It will only come to one who does not want power — only restoration.'

choices.text: Go alone — take the river south

scenes.text: The river carries you south, past ruins of the old kingdom. You wash up at the base of a tower. A rope ladder hangs from the window above.

choices.text: Climb the ladder to the tower

scenes.text: The witch smiles but does not answer. Instead she presses a warm coal into your palm. It does not burn. 'For when the dark gets thick,' she says.

choices.text: Continue on to the sealed door

scenes.text: The moment your fingers close around the Crown, the dust lifts. The throne room breathes. Outside, the Ashwood erupts in blossom. The kingdom stirs.
Silence. Then a voice from everywhere at once: 'Only the worthy reach this room. You have been watched since the Ashwood threshold. You may take the Crown — or leave it and free us all.'

choices.text: Take the Crown — restore the kingdom
Leave the Crown — break the binding

scenes.text: You step back. The Crown shatters into a thousand embers that fly upward and become stars. The forest exhales. Whatever was bound here is free. So are you.
